title: Every surviving bounded profile is extensive but anchor-free

survivor_geometry.l2_necessity: A possible negative order-N^4 descent must have B_N=Omega(N^3); K1666 excludes B_N=o(N^3).
survivor_geometry.support_floor: Under rho_k<=rho_+, B_N<=rho_+^2|supp rho|, so support cardinality o(N^3) cannot survive.
survivor_geometry.threshold_lemma: If B_N>=bN^3 and d_N<=c_1N^3, tau^2=b/(2c_1) gives |{k:rho_k>=tau}|>=bN^3/(2rho_+^2).
survivor_geometry.remaining_geometry: K1668 removes threshold sets containing a macroscopic complete cube; the remaining known-profile orbit sector has extensive fixed-threshold support but no such anchor.
survivor_geometry.scope_guard: This is a necessary survivor classification, not an existence claim, localization theorem, coefficient-changing construction or theorem for unknown/non-orbit laws.
